verification_command: go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.13.1 && go install github.com/bufbuild/buf/cmd/buf@v1.60.0 && "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/golangci-lint" run --timeout=3m && go test -p 1 ./... && cd web && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && cd ../proto && "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/buf" lint && if [[ $("$(go env GOPATH)/bin/buf" format -d) ]]; then echo "❌ Proto files are not formatted. Run 'buf format -w' to fix."; exit 1; fi
